texts:
Kansas City won @LV and lost two receivers doing it.

Rashee Rice hurt his hamstring.

Tyquan Thornton dislocated his ankle.

Monitor both.

Week 4's leftovers run from there through every game Sunday played.

Let's dive in.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Rashee Rice tweaked his hamstring; one report says several weeks. KC is off in Week 5. WR17 rest of season for me; monitor Andy Reid's update.

Tyquan Thornton caught 5 for 111 and 2 TDs, then dislocated his ankle. Out indefinitely; monitor the diagnosis.
#ChiefsKingdom

Kyle Monangai ran 30 times for 146 and 2 TDs vs NYJ after D'Andre Swift lost a fumble and sat. His thumb gets checked Monday. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent.

Swift is RB13 rest of season for me; hold him.
#DaBears

Emanuel Wilson ran 21 times for 81 and a TD vs LAC and caught a screen for a second TD. Price is on IR and Charbonnet on PUP.

Claim Wilson, 15 to 25 percent of FAAB.
#Seahawks

Saquon Barkley lasted 4 snaps; the hamstring is not believed serious. RB8 rest of season for me; monitor Wednesday.

Tank Bigsby played 29 snaps, then got hurt late. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent.

Will Shipley played 28 snaps. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.
#FlyEaglesFly

Ja'Marr Chase left with a concussion after 3 catches. Monitor the protocol.

Tee Higgins caught 11 for 157, then strained his groin late. Monitor Wednesday's report.

Chase Brown caught 10 for 62. RB6 rest of season for me; hold him.
#WhoDey

Thursday's game first.

Jaylen Warren played 69 of 71 snaps @CLE. Hold him until Rico Dowdle is back.

Denzel Boston played 95 percent of the snaps with 7 targets. Trade for him; offer a bench RB.
#HereWeGo #DawgPound

Michael Wilson had 13 targets at NYG, 30 in two games. Trade for him; offer a bench WR3.

Malik Nabers caught 6 of 7 for 112 and a TD through a shoulder hit. WR13 rest of season for me.
#BirdGang #NYGiants

Kenneth Walker III ran 22 times for 177 and 2 TDs on 75 percent of the snaps. RB4 rest of season for me.

Michael Mayer had 10 targets next to Brock Bowers' 11. Add Mayer in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Marcus Mariota sprained his MCL, and the Commanders finished with their third quarterback. Drop Mariota.

Jonathan Taylor ran 20 times for 95 and 2 TDs. RB3 rest of season for me.
#RaiseHail #ForTheShoe

Lamar Jackson left in a walking boot with a sprained ankle. QB2 rest of season for me; he is week to week pending the MRI.

Zay Flowers caught 8 of 10 for 118 and a TD. WR11 rest of season for me.

Carnell Tate caught 9 for 145. WR34 for me.
#RavensFlock #TitanUp

Keon Coleman ran a route on 31 of 40 dropbacks with DJ Moore hurt, 6 for 116 and a TD. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.

Rhamondre Stevenson out-snapped TreVeyon Henderson 35 to 25 and scored. RB23 rest of season for me.
#BillsMafia #NEPats

Bhayshul Tuten out-snapped Chris Rodriguez 36 to 15 and lost two TDs to holding, then hobbled off. Monitor Wednesday's report.

Brenton Strange led Jacksonville with 8 targets, 7 for 95. Add him, 2 to 4 percent.
#DUUUVAL

Rome Odunze caught 6 of 7 for 94 from Tyson Bagent. WR32 rest of season for me.

Braelon Allen took all 14 Jets running back carries for 59. RB50 rest of season for me; hold him while Hall is out.
#DaBears #JetUp

Aaron Jones Sr. ran 20 times for 94 and caught 4 for 34. RB30 rest of season for me.

Ollie Gordon II ran 9 times for 100 and a TD; Jaylen Wright ran 5 for 7. Hold Gordon.
#Skol #PhinsUp

Kyren Williams played 70 snaps to Blake Corum's 13 and caught 10 of 13. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.

Darius Cooper played 90 percent of the snaps and scored twice on a team-high 7 targets. Add him, 2 to 5 percent.
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly

Chuba Hubbard ran 20 times for 122 and 2 TDs. RB27 rest of season for me.

Jameson Williams caught 6 for 102 as Jared Goff threw 52 times. WR27 rest of season for me.
#KeepPounding #OnePride

CeeDee Lamb caught 17 for 189 and the winning TD @HOU. WR4 rest of season for me.

Nico Collins caught 7 of 8 for 118 and 2 TDs back from the hamstring. WR8 rest of season for me.
#DallasCowboys #HTownMade

RJ Harvey caught 10 for 68 while J.K. Dobbins played 42 percent of the snaps. Add Harvey in PPR, 2 to 5 percent.

George Kittle caught 4 for 70 and a 56-yard TD. TE10 rest of season for me.
#BroncosCountry #FTTB

Kaleb Johnson fumbled at the goal line, and Matt LaFleur threatened the bench. Leave Johnson on the wire.

Tucker Kraft caught 6 for 42 and a TD. TE6 rest of season for me.

Jalon Daniels ran 8 times for 56 in his first start. Leave him on the wire.
#GoPackGo #GoBucs

Los Angeles split its backfield three ways @SEA.

Keaton Mitchell had 15 touches. Add him, 1 to 3 percent.

Omarion Hampton ran 9 times for 41 and a TD. RB12 rest of season for me; hold him.
#BoltUp

Real.

Tetairoa McMillan caught 14 of 16 for 192 and 2 TDs with Coker out. Trade for him during the bye; offer a WR2.

Puka Nacua caught 9 for 125 in his first game since Week 1. Trade for him; offer a WR2 and an RB3.
#KeepPounding #RamsHouse

Noise.

Woody Marks scored again, but David Montgomery out-snapped him 32 to 20. Hold Montgomery.

T.J. Hockenson caught 13 of 13 with Justin Jefferson out, and Jefferson is aiming for Week 5. Trade Hockenson away; ask for a WR3.
#HTownMade #Skol

The misses.

Drake Maye was a sit for me; he threw 3 TDs and ran for 54.

Josh Downs was WR15 for me; he caught 3 for 16.

Khalil Shakir was a sit; he caught 7 for 82.

Thin rooms and running quarterbacks beat my ranks.
#NEPats #ForTheShoe #BillsMafia

Every takeaway, usage note and overreaction from Week 4 is on the site, with Monday night going into Tuesday's waiver run.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/leftovers.html?week=4
